answer_1.quote: We evaluate LLMs (e.g., GPT-4) with different prompting methods on CRT-QA.

answer_2.quote: Following Chen, 2023b, we use Markdown as the format of tables and use Exact Match (EM) as the main metric for evaluations.

answer_4.quote: We enroll 2 undergraduate students and 1 Ph.D. student majoring in computer science for data annotations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to select the type of reasoning or operation for each step and fill in templates specifying objectives of the chosen type.
